title: feat(app-shell): send the console UI language as context.uiLocale on the AI chat request
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBNgJrQDxaUNx2so1ektgf6A)_

Fixes #34639

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:AI 对话请求的 `body.context` 新增 `uiLocale`,值为控制台当前解析出的界面语言(`useObjectTranslation().language`),其余字段不变。
- **为什么改**:服务端此前只看得到浏览器的 `Accept-Language`,中文提问 + 英文控制台时,回复让用户点「开始搭建」,而计划卡按钮显示的是 "Build it";cloud PR #4815 的 `consoleUiLocaleOf` 读这个键来选按钮文案。
- **风险与回滚**:风险低,只是请求体多一个字符串键,服务端自行校验、不认识就丢弃;回滚即 revert 本 PR,服务端退回按回复语言选文案(今天的行为)。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`(`useObjectChat` 的 `body.context` 末尾新增的 `uiLocale: language` 一行);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.uiLocale-34639.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.uiLocale-34639.test.tsx`,预期 5 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `ChatPane` (`AiChatPage.tsx`) already read `const { t, language } = useObjectTranslation()`. The `useObjectChat({ body: { context } })` call now adds `uiLocale: language` beside `activeApp`, `agentName`, `autoPublishAiBuilds`, `packageId` and `surface`. The value is sent as is; there is no client-side normalisation, because the consumer (objectstack-ai/cloud PR #4815, `consoleUiLocaleOf`) validates it.
- Console dock: read `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ChatDock.tsx` and `ChatDockConversation.tsx`. The dock does not build its own chat request. It mounts the same `ChatPane`, so this one change covers the dock too. No dock file is edited. The only non-test `useObjectChat(` call sites under `ui/packages` are `AiChatPage.tsx` and the SDUI `plugin-chatbot` renderer, which is not the console's AI chat.
- Changeset: `.changeset/34639-ai-chat-ui-locale.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Tests

New file `AiChatPage.uiLocale-34639.test.tsx`. It renders `ChatPane` with a real `I18nProvider` and with `useObjectChat` replaced by an options recorder, the same harness as `AiChatPage.surfaceChipLabel-8219.test.tsx`. The expected value is read from a probe under the same provider, so the pin does not depend on how the provider spells a tag. It checks:

1. `en` / `zh` / `de` consoles: `context.uiLocale` equals the resolved UI language (non-empty string).
2. Chinese thread under an English console versus a Chinese console: each sends its own console's language, and the two values differ.
3. The rest of the context is unchanged: keys are exactly `agentName`, `autoPublishAiBuilds`, `uiLocale` for a pane with no app, package or surface.

No shared ChatPane harness file exists under `console/ai/__tests__/`, so the pin is its own card-named file.

<details><summary>Ablation (fix committed first; mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

Deleted the line `uiLocale: language,` (anchor 1 -> 0, blob 6e4da2c7 -> e6d51027). The test imports `../AiChatPage` from source, so no build step sits between the mutation and the run.

```

× zh console: context.uiLocale is the resolved UI language        expected undefined to be 'zh'

× the value follows the console, not the conversation ...         expected undefined to be 'en'
```

## Acceptance notes

- PR #34713, which rewrote `AiChatPage.tsx`, merged before this PR opened. The branch merged origin/main (dfbc316d) cleanly. `overlap-check` on head 82eed1dc reported `VERDICT clean exit 0` (origin/main merges cleanly, 0 overlapping PR heads).
- The console's own language resolution (browser vs environment default) is out of scope, as the card says.
